Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding between the District and Bay Area Community Resources, San Rafael, CA, adding to the Scope of Work set forth in the August 26, 2020 Agreement (Legislative File No. 20-1178, Enactment No. 20-1206) the following paragraphs to the existing Scope of Work: 

Amended Scope of Work

VENDOR will provide in-person learning supports to students in K-5 at Sankofa United Elementary School. In-person learning supports may include (but are not limited to) support with accessing technology, facilitating access to classroom zoom sessions, motivating students to complete work, providing one-to-one mentoring or encouragement, and connecting with supplemental services if needed, and other supports as directed by OUSD.

All other terms and condition of the Memorandum of Understanding remain in full force and effect.
